subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should this PR wait for real embedded-agent proof of the internal-handoff drop and `sessions_send` preservation paths before maintainers choose between this branch and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: The repo requires real behavior proof for external PRs, and green helper tests do not settle the six-source session-state predicate or the overlap with the broader proven repair.

options.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording from a real embedded-agent run showing stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

options.title: Accept maintainer-held proof
options.body: Proceed only if maintainers already have equivalent private runtime evidence and explicitly accept the six-source predicate scope.

options.title: Pause behind the broader repair
options.body: Leave this branch waiting or close it later if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 becomes the chosen canonical fix.

recommendation.title: Require real embedded-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording from a real embedded-agent run showing stale internal handoff text is dropped while `sessions_send` content is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in the earlier active-turn repair.
